Amendments to government bill by Coalition and Greens would establish protections for those reporting wrongdoing in sport

  • Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast

Whistleblowers coming forward to report corruption or misconduct in sports would be protected under draft laws put forward by the Coalition and the Greens, in response to the fallout of the Australian cricket ball tampering scandal.

The South Africa tour of 2018 is back in the national spotlight after the release of Usman Khawaja’s autobiography earlier this month, in which he claimed players had used sandpaper to tamper with the ball before the third Test on the infamous tour, and that the entire squad knew about the practice.
